entities.summary: Werner Goldberg was a German who served as a Heer soldier of the Wehrmacht during World War II and later, a politician of West Germany post-war. He is best known for a picture of him which appeared in the Berliner Tageblatt, as "The Ideal German Soldier". He was of half Jewish ancestry, or a Mischling in Nazi terminology.
